questions.subject: BUSINESS_ENTREPRENEURSHIP

stimulus.body: A newly formed team at Flintgroup will produce a new skin-care creams line. Members are enthusiastic but lack the skills and experience needed for the tasks.

questions.stem: Flintgroup, what is the most appropriate leadership response for this team?

options.text: Provide clear direction and close supervision until skills develop
Ask the team to set its own goals with no structure
options.misconception: Removes the direction novices require

options.text: Delegate all decisions immediately and stay uninvolved
options.misconception: Unsuitable for an inexperienced team needing guidance

options.text: Focus only on social activities and avoid task guidance
options.misconception: Neglects the competence-building need

questions.explanation: Situational leadership matches the leader's style to follower readiness. New, unable teams need a directing style with clear instructions and close supervision, while delegating suits highly ready teams.
questions.hint: Novice teams need direction before autonomy.
